advisories.title: Glob: AbortSignal cancellation bypass allows post-timeout filesystem traversal
minimatch has potential denial of service via globparts amplification

chain: create-bolt-uxp@1.3.27 -> meta-bolt -> archiver -> archiver-utils -> glob@10.5.0 and zip-stream -> minimatch@9.0.9
npmSuggestedFix: npm audit reports fixAvailable as create-bolt-uxp@0.2.5, marked isSemVerMajor. That is an older release, not a forward fix of 1.3.27. It was not applied.
reachability: create-bolt-uxp createBoltUXP calls meta-bolt main. meta-bolt zipPackage is a separate export that uses archiver.directory. The skill scaffold path does not call zipPackage. The fixture runner and the acceptance scaffold do not demonstrate the AbortSignal bypass or the minimatch amplification. A generated plugin's own npm install is a separate tree and was not this audit.
decision: Leave create-bolt-uxp pinned at 1.3.27. Residual risk is moderate, transitive, and latent in the unused zip helper.
